policy: Hakata NPC hunt. The guide supplies the offer, targets, turn-in, timers and rewards. AC2E assigns the journal ID.

quests.title: Thin the Boglurk Armoredillos
quests.text: Lily needs the Boglurk Armoredillos cleared before her miners can work. Defeat ten, then return to Lily Patenkan in Hakata.
